left_out.label: Club
left_out.reason: A player's season row sits under his last club, so a club-filtered pooled line would credit a traded player's whole season to the club he ended with. The Teams scope is the club view.

left_out.label: Scouting grade cells
left_out.reason: No group is keyed by a scouting grade (FV, eFV or a consensus grade): a realized statistic by grade cell is never computed here (docs/PROSPECT_ANCHOR_GATE.md).

left_out.label: Against left- or right-handed opponents
left_out.reason: Matchup splits are out of scope: the club split by opposing hand is the input to the pre-registered 5e test (docs/diamond-betting.md), and the per-hand HEM+ estimator changed under M17-3. The hand filter here is the player's own side.

deferred.label: wOBA
deferred.reason: Pooled wOBA waits for X02-08 and M06-18: the boards compute wOBA on the frozen 2013 weights while league_constants solves each season, so a League wOBA would disagree with the column beside it.

notes.method: League is pooled: each numerator summed over the players shown, over the denominator summed the same way, through the shipped derivations. Player mean, median and SD (sample SD) are over players with 100 or more PA (20 or more IP). Indexes are weighted by plate appearances or innings and read on each board's own scale; 100 is the average qualified player of that board, not the league mean. Descriptive: not a forecast.
notes.baserunning: Not joined: the Baserunning plan's payload does not exist yet. Runner-record rates are never computed here.
